reviews.x: I just received and used this flat iron love love love this flat iron.i have an $100 Amica that I haven't used in over 5 yrs.Im African American who went natural close to 3 yrs and this is perfect soon as you plug it in it's hot the plates move back and forth has swivel cord,digital settings don't let the price fool you.think I'm going to order another one in case this one breaks

got it Sept 21st and today it turned on, overheated and died.. DONT BUY. I bought a knock off CHI once and had it for 8 yeas, this one is crap. you just never know. It stated off not being very hot on the ceramics.

reviews.t: Doesn't work for more than a few seconds.. ...
reviews.x: Doesn't work for more than a few seconds...than displays some code that we can't figure out because there is nothing mentioned in the directions about what to do when this code comes up. Sending it back very soon!

reviews.t: This is a nice straightener. I would say it heats up in ...
reviews.x: This is a nice straightener.  I would say it heats up in just a few minutes so I wish it would heat up a bit faster but overall a great product for the price.

reviews.t: Like it except it has just enough gap for a ...
reviews.x: Like it except it has just enough gap for a few strands of hair to get caught and pulled out. Have to be very careful not to slide it through my hair.

Loved this at first. Then after a few months I found the heat, even at lowest temp, burnt my hair. lowest heat option is for very thick hair.  I've had to have hair treatments & am still waiting for full healthy hair to return. Never had this prob w/other flat irons. Writing review months after purchasing this, to share experience. Maybe my hair responded differently than others, just had to post my experience cause it's not fun dealing with burnt hair.

reviews.t: I don'l like that some of my very long hair gets stuck ...
reviews.x: This is OK, I don'l like that some of my very long hair gets stuck on the sides.

Heats up very well only thing I didn't like was that it does not lock closed while heating up. I also don't like that it does not have a memory it has to be set Everytime you turn it on. Other than that it does it's job.
Its "Ok", nothing special, & I don't know that it does anything above and beyond what my old school curling iron did.  Happy I made the purchased on a lightening deal & not full price!
I have wavy curly hair and this flat iron made my hair frizzy. The plates don't touch, I have to squeeze it shut and hold the end which gets super hot. My hair slides out of the flat iron.
No better than my original RED ceramic flat iron. The only plus to this flat iron is the digital dial. Does not heat up hot enough nor does it straighten well.
Within 6 months of purchase, this item completely quit working. Very disappointed. I expect things to work longer than that.
Does not straighten hair as well as other flat irons. Would have returned but my return window expired.
Perfect to get a quickly use, light to pick up and very fast to lower or higher the temperature.
Ordered on a lightning deal. This arrived used and covered in gunk from hair products. Gross

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: Im only giving it 4 because it was a good price. That said, you get what you pay for. It doesn’t close all the way unless you squeeze it and it doesn’t glide through hair very gently nor curl very good. It would make a good iron for a young girl just starting to use one. It is small and comfortable if you are like me and have small hands and it does heat up quickly. If you are looking for simply a straightener, this might be for you. However, if you want a styling tool, ignore the low price and

Love this flat iron.  I've never been very good with a flat iron but decided to try this one.  It has several heat setting that are easy to set.  The cord is long.  And best of all it works well.  I have very fine straight hair and this is easy to straighten or curl my hair and it seems to hold the style much longer than my curling iron.  It fits my hand well and is easy to manipulate.  I would definitely recommend this and would purchase it again.

Exactly what I was looking for. Not many flat irons go up to the heat that I was looking for to get my natural 4a/4b hair as straight as I want. I only need to pass it once or twice and love the auto off function. However, depending on how you hold it you can accidentally turn it off. I've done it a couple times but it heats back up quickly so its not a big deal for me.

I originally bought this for my teen daughter but when I needed mine and she took it for a sleepover at a friend's house,  it quickly became my Christmas gift to myself.  I love that it has a digital setting that allows me to change the temperature to the exact number I want it. It does a great job.  For once,  I'm glad my child took something of mine without asking!

I cannot describe (although I'll try because I'm writing a review) to describe just how much I love this flat iron!  There is an LED temperature display on the top of the iron.  It heats up quickly and there is a swivel cord to prevent tangles.  It is easy to increase the temperature.  The iron has a nice feel in my hand and it is well made.

This was an awesome buy for me! I have very curly hair and I was able to straighten it in less than 15 minutes. The ceramic plating glides smoothly through my hair without any pulling and even though I had the temperature all the way up, there was no burning smell that I'v gotten from other straighteners. :)

reviews.t: Reviews said it wasn't good for thin hair but it was perfect for my ...
reviews.x: I have very thick curly hair and this couldn't handle it. Reviews said it wasn't good for thin hair but it was perfect for my daughter's thin curly hair. I loved that I could decrease the temp. She gets this one and I'll stick with my chi. Shipping was quick and it was great for the price.

reviews.t: Got a great deal on this and its a good straightener
reviews.x: Got a great deal on this and its a good straightener. Does its job, heats up quickly and a long cord which is actually more of an asset than I thought! My old one would come unplugged all the time and drove me nuts

reviews.t: Great product at a great price.
reviews.x: I love this. It works great and at a great price. Different heat levels, you can straighten and with practice, even curl. Easy to transport and store. Holds heat well and evenly. Best one I have bought yet.

reviews.t: ... quite as well as my CHI- but still a good product for the price
reviews.x: works well- not quite as well as my CHI- but still a good product for the price. Gets hot quickly, small plates and they tend to snag my hairs on the outside sometimes, otherwise an excellent product!

claims.text: Several reviewers report the flat iron stopped working or died after a short time, including overheating and quitting within months.
Some reviewers say it does not heat up hot enough or does not straighten hair well.
Multiple reviewers mention hair getting caught, pulled, or stuck in the plates or sides.
Some reviewers praise it as a good value that heats up quickly and is easy to use.
A few reviewers complain about missing features like not locking closed or lacking a memory setting.
